message: Trapped behind enemy lines, U.S. soldiers faced death from all sides—bullets, bombs, and even their own army’s fire. Hope was fading. One last chance remained: a wounded pigeon named Cher Ami.

message: Shot, bleeding, and barely alive, she soared through the smoke-filled sky. Enemies fired. Her leg dangled, one eye gone, yet she flew—faster than death.

author: @Surya_VT
message: She reached command, message tied to her shattered leg. The shelling stopped. 194 lives were saved.Cher Ami didn’t just deliver a note—she delivered a miracle
